description: Decentralized P2P file sharing: search other users' shared libraries, browse their folders, chat rooms and private messages, no central server.
notes: Not portable: Fopnu rewrites its .dat files, which would break Scoop's persist.
Settings, the library and transfers live in %APPDATA%\fopnu, survive updates and are kept on uninstall.
If Fopnu offers a new version, update with 'scoop update Fopnu' instead of running its installer.
pre_install: # A fresh install stops if the app is running or its data files are in use (scripts/common/Test-AppBusy.ps1).
# Updates are checked in pre_uninstall, which Scoop runs before it removes the old version.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { error "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$busyCheck' is missing."; break }
if ($busy) { error "$app is in use. Close it (and anything holding its files open) and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }
# The installer is a small stub with fopnu.exe as a bzip2 resource; 7-Zip unpacks it as '<id>~'.
pre_uninstall: # 'scoop update' and 'scoop uninstall' stop here, before anything is removed, if the app is running
# or its data files are in use (scripts/common/Test-AppBusy.ps1).
# Without the helper (e.g. the bucket was removed) only warn: uninstalling must stay possible.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { warn "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$busyCheck' is missing."; return }
if ($busy) { error "$app is in use. Close it (and anything holding its files open) and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }
